prompt.en: Which type of industry gives jobs to more working Canadians than any other?
prompt.fr: Quel type d'industrie emploie plus de Canadiens au travail que tout autre?

explanation.en: Service industries employ the largest share of working Canadians. They cover thousands of different jobs, from health care and teaching to banking and tourism.
explanation.fr: Les industries de services emploient la plus grande part des Canadiens au travail. Elles regroupent des milliers d'emplois différents, des soins de santé et de l'enseignement jusqu'aux banques et au tourisme.

source.quote: More than 75% of working Canadians now have jobs in service industries.

verification.evidence: More than 75% of working Canadians now have jobs in service industries.
